Since then, eTribez has been a leading provider of digital solutions to the global television and film industry. eTribez has built a reputation for providing TV and film production companies with software solutions which increase efficiency, streamline production processes, save time and money, and at the same time secure personal data within our ISO 27001 certified cloud-based platforms. Within eTribez’ scope of deliveries is eTribez PM, a cloud-based Production Management platform comprised of Finance, Talent Management, Planning, Scheduling, Document Management, Resource Management and Post-Production modules. The eTribez PM Platform is currently implemented with a variety of Television and Film production companies across the globe, handling over 1,000 productions from all genres – non-scripted series, TV drama series, documentary films and feature films. eTribez operates in 19 territories, including the US, UK, France, and Germany. eTribez works with some of the biggest production companies in the industry including: ITV Studios, Fremantle, Lime Pictures, Studio Lambert, RAW TV, All3Media America, RTL, 1895 films, Hearst TV and more. MANAGEMENT Prior to founding eTribez, Eli was a managing partner in a mini Venture Capital fund and served as a member of the BOD of Clear Applications and P-Kama. Prior to that Eli was the CFO and Business Development manager of Yanushevsky E&C, and a senior consultant at PriceWaterhouseCoopers. ELI ABAYAN CEO & Co-Founder Prior to joining eTribez, Nir founded Nuiti Labs and served as its VP Marketing and Business Development. Prior to that, Nir managed a User Experience team at Mediamind Technologies and worked for 6 years in the Israeli Air Force as a User Experience Expert. NIR SEGAL CPO & Co-Founder Prior to joining eTribez, Shahar was a head of a financial team at BDI, In charge of the provident Funds section which had managed approx. $6.5B in net assets. Prior to that, Shahar was a team leader and senior portfolio advisor at BDO, both at the banking and the private sectors, offering auditing and financial consultancy services. Shahar is a certified P.A. SHAHAR ANGEL CFO Giannola joined eTribez after spending many years in the events industry. She worked as Business Leader at cievents UK, where she managed the Venue Sourcing team. She then transitioned to leading and delivering global implementations of OBTs and Event Management Tools at FCM Travel Solutions . GIANNOLA CIMENTI VP of Customer Success Nimrod has over 18 years of experience in the online industry, both as an entrepreneur, a corporate executive and an investor. Most recently, he co-founded and serves as General Partner at Inimiti, a new micro-fund, focused on early stage investments in the New Media space. NIMROD LEV Board Member | General Partner, Inimiti VC Fred serves as an international consultant to Harpo Productions (Chicago & LA). He was also Executive Vice President of CBS Broadcast International. Earlier in his career, Fred was the first President of HBO International (London/New York). Cohen is Chairman of the International Academy of Television Arts & Sciences (International Emmys). The platform provides innovative tools to manage planning and scheduling, finance and budget, staffing and casting, logistics, production entities and resources, and more – cross-production and during all production phases: pre-production, production and post-production. With our Production Management platform, we give producers and broadcasters an extensive variety of digital solutions to aid in and enhance the entire production process. In addition to production-level solutions, the platform also offers a powerful management tool for executives. Using real-time dashboards, views and reports, production company executives can track the planning, progress, budget and resources of each production, make accurate decisions on time, and manage the company’s resources in an efficient and agile way. The perfect synergy of production management solutions helps you manage all your production needs. You’ll save on time, financial resources, manpower, and more – all while conducting a smooth and efficient production process. Our integrated management platform covers all aspects of production in one place – from casting and budgeting to planning, scheduling, legal issues, locations, staff members, resource management and more. Cross-Production View for Production Companies The eTribez platform provides production houses with a cross-production overview in one dashboard, helping them manage their resources in a highly efficient and effective way. Using real-time dashboards, views and reports, executives can track the planning, progress, and budget for all their production needs. Highly Secured, ISO 27001 and SOC2 Certified, and GDPR-Compliant We take your data seriously, and our platform and solutions meet the high security standards and data privacy requirements that our clients require. We are ISO 27001 and SOC2 certified, and fully compliant with the GDPR. We continuously update our privacy policy, business processes, and agreements to ensure the highest level of security and data protection for our clients. Fully-Scalable SaaS Cloud-Based System Our fully scalable SaaS solution is designed to support any production requirements – with no installation or IT concerns. From simple automation to sophisticated special tools based on accumulated data, we cover all production requirements in one cloud-based system, enabling clients to manage resources that can be shared with organizations for small productions up to dozens of films and TV shows a year.
